results.evidence: The 001_baseline.sql header (lines 4-5) says migration files must not contain BEGIN, COMMIT or ROLLBACK. The _apply docstring in cottonwood/db.py (line 193) says the same. `uv run --offline pytest -q tests/test_migration_transaction_docs.py tests/test_migrate.py` gave 27 passed, so the runner still accepts 001 with the new header. The runner refuses a file that contains transaction control as SQL; the header words are inside `--` comments, and the tests pass.
results.quote:
-- The runner wraps each file in its own transaction, so migration files must not contain
-- BEGIN, COMMIT or ROLLBACK (a file that does is refused before it runs).
